title: Say My Name: a Model’s Bias Discovery Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Generating captions for correctly and incorrectly classified images using a multimodal LLM, extracting textual keywords, and computing cosine similarity with learned class embeddings to identify the model's reliance on spurious background correlations (e.g., identifying background features in the Waterbirds, BAR, and ImageNet-A datasets).

Applying the text-based keyword extraction and embedding similarity pipeline to the CelebA dataset to discover spurious correlations between a specific target task (e.g., classifying 'blond hair') and perceived gender or associated societal stereotypes (e.g., extracting keywords like 'woman', 'man', 'makeup', 'lipstick').
